snippet.title: Dungeon Gems - LaunchTrailer
snippet.description:
Choose your element and sharpen your mind in an epic thrilling RPG-style game with fast-paced PUZZLE gameplay. With hundreds of Heroes to choose from, battle  through dungeons of fire and ice and hunt down the dragons, all in gorgeous 3D!

Download the game now for free:

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gameloft.android.ANMP.GloftFBHM
iOS App Store:  https://itunes.apple.com/app/id714735173

SOON ON WINDOWS PHONE

Follow the game on Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/DungeonGems

Visit our official site at http://www.gameloft.com

Check out our videos and game trailers on http://www.youtube.com/Gameloft.
